title: Build a Resumable Live Headlines Stream
prompt: Implement a callbackFlow-backed SSE or WebSocket client with states, authentication, bounded buffering, heartbeat, resume IDs, deduplication, snapshot recovery, and cancellation.
successCriteria: Reconnect uses capped jitter and stops on permanent failure.
Duplicate and missing sequence cases reconcile correctly.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class LiveHeadlineClient(/* transport, snapshot source, clock */)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
